description: Source code for managing cache rankings and linked list operations within the disk cache subsystem, including transaction handling, crash simulation, and list integrity checks.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Handles crash-safe transactions for list modifications, ensuring crash recovery.

classes.name: Rankings
classes.description: Manages cache ranking lists, including insertion, removal, validation, and crash recovery.

methods.name: GenerateCrash
methods.description: Simulates crashes at specific code locations for testing crash recovery.

methods.name: UpdateTimes
methods.description: Updates last used and last modified timestamps of ranking nodes.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the rankings system with backend and configuration.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a node into the ranking list, maintaining list integrity.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a node from the ranking list, handling list updates and crash safety.

methods.name: UpdateRank
methods.description: Updates the position of a node in the ranking list.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next node in the ranking list.

methods.name: GetPrev
methods.description: Retrieves the previous node in the ranking list.

methods.name: CheckLinks
methods.description: Validates the integrity of links between nodes.

methods.name: CheckSingleLink
methods.description: Checks the consistency of a single link between two nodes.

methods.name: SelfCheck
methods.description: Performs internal consistency checks of the ranking lists.
